class.name: rov2_plugins::MockSensor
class.description: Mock sensor plugin that emits a synthetic incrementing reading each tick.

class.name: rov2_plugins::MockActuator
class.description: Mock actuator plugin that records the last commanded Twist.

class.name: rov2_plugins::NoopBrain
class.description: No-op brain plugin. The framework is a nervous system, not a brain.

class.name: rov2_plugins::Drivetrain
class.description: Four-wheel skid-steer drivetrain. Expands a body Twist into four wheel speeds on the shared Yahboom board.

class.name: rov2_plugins::NavImu
class.description: Publishes the Yahboom onboard 9-axis IMU as sensor_msgs/Imu (navigation source).

class.name: rov2_plugins::Battery
class.description: Publishes pack voltage from the shared Yahboom board as sensor_msgs/BatteryState.

class.name: rov2_plugins::WheelEncoders
class.description: Raw wheel-encoder feedback (per-wheel angle + velocity) from the shared Yahboom board as sensor_msgs/JointState.

class.name: rov2_plugins::Odometry
class.description: Calibrated wheel odometry integrated from the shared Yahboom board encoders, published as nav_msgs/Odometry.
